items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: we had a very good singer. Her name was Joan Lunsford. Her right name was Daisy Lowe, but I gave her the name as Joan Lunsford.

ctx.x: No, we played Havana, and we played other towns around. And I can't recall any of the towns. I have a scrapbook here with some of the towns. But we played there, we had a big welcome there. And it was a pretty nice trip, and we came back and we played all through Florida, because we had been going to Florida time and time. And then we traveled with the Mills Brothers through Florida and Georgia. They had our band and the Mills Brothers together. And that was successful. And we had a very good singer. Her name was…
And she was a very, very fine singer, and everybody liked her every place she went.
